log.msg: bug 2 fixed: Echo.js's page_set() sent {id} instead of {target:[id]} to the page_set tool, so the delta landed on the PAGE itself (the title-wipe). page_tools.js already had the correct target-array contract (a377158a). Bug 3 (by: "agent") was already fixed by the same contract (ctx.caller) -- the test pins it too.

bug 4 fixed: AIRail.route()'s two callers (ai/page.js, ai2/page.js) each hand-listed a shorter copy of the ids the rail actually routes, so "your-prompts" fell through to a 404. Added AIRail.handles(id) as the one shared list, plus a your-prompts branch in AIRail.route() that asks the mounted rail to recompute its pinned item and draws it with full(). Verified with a headless shot: /framework/ai/your-prompts/ and /framework/ai2/your-prompts/ both render, no 404. Committed 61b10007.

bug 6 fixed: fold_events() marks a card's creation line made:true; news_of() never picks it as the 'what happened' bar, and no longer falls back to a placeholder (vscode-mastermind caught 'Something changed here' live, same complaint as 'Made this card: Now') -- it now tries about_line() (the card's own summary), then its log.text ('doing' line), then its newest content item's title, else no bar at all. Also added a title= tooltip to the score badge (it.reason, already computed in rail.js decorate()) so 94/99 explain themselves on hover. Verified live via shot: Now card preview reads a real sentence, not a placeholder.

content-row rendering, 3 fixes from live feedback at 1920/3440: (1) .page-content-text now sets --flow:var(--gap) so md(text)'s .flow wrapper uses card rhythm, not page rhythm -- fixes ~60px gaps under a bold line. (2) ext/Mention: @task-mastermind-... agent ids are minted per-task and can't live in the static people.js roster -- added agent_entry() shape-based fallback (task-mastermind-/mastermind-/minion-/manager-/assistant- -> a small icon mention, no link). (3) an inline #Page/#Item/#List mention (class_card:true) is the same oversized tappable .item box as any mention, just invisible until .page-surface-dark paints it solid -- tightened .mention.inline.page-surface-dark only. Committed c4cc5466. Verified live via shot of /framework/ai2/2026/10/03/now/ at 1920.

log.msg: bug 7 (plain-word titles): card_set refused me on another mastermind's card (ownership boundary, correct behavior) -- sent the rename as a recommendation to mastermind-servex instead, plus added the rule to create_card's own `title` field description (Servex/cards/Cards.js, commit 3ec9a5a7) since that's code I can own; the matching skill-line edit is mastermind-servex's to make (skills are its own).

bug 5 root-caused and fixed: used Server/browser.mjs headless (never mcp__playwright after vscode-mastermind flagged it opening visible windows) to reproduce -- clicking Activity then a rail card threw 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading ac)' inside Router.mark()'s page.view.ac() call, because the Activity tab's activated() runs card.redraw() synchronously outside any render() of its own, leaving one page in the chain without a .view for a moment. The throw happened INSIDE mark()'s .map(), so this.marked never got reassigned and this.path (set right after activate() returns) never updated either -- every later click hit the same wall since this.active still pointed at the broken chain. Fixed Router.mark() to use page.view?.ac(...) + filter(Boolean) so one broken page can't corrupt navigation for every click after it (commit 8b5ba516). Verified headless: card -> Activity -> Live -> back to the same card, zero console errors, real content renders each time. The deeper question (why redraw-during-activate leaves a page view-less for a moment) is still open -- flagged in the commit message as a follow-up, not re-chased today (budget).
